description.p: FileLocker lets you create encrypted vaults on your Linux desktop. Each vault is a directory whose contents and filenames are encrypted at rest using gocryptfs with AES-GCM. Vaults are mounted via FUSE so they appear as a normal folder when unlocked.

ul.li: Multiple vaults, each with its own password
Auto-lock on idle or screen lock
Recovery key shown once at creation
Stealth mode to hide vaults from the list
